name: Ben Lambert A Graduate Course in Econometrics
desc: Graduate econometrics lecture series by Ben Lambert covering the matrix formulation of econometrics: vector differentiation, derivation of Ordinary Least Squares estimators, expectations and variance of random vectors, unbiasedness and the Gauss-Markov theorem, the geometric interpretation of least squares and orthogonal projection, error variance estimation, GLS under heteroscedasticity and autocorrelation, Kronecker products and SURE estimation, and causal inference with the Rubin causal model, selection bias, random assignment, conditional independence, and propensity score matching.
